sharedContext: WAVE-500 coordination-overhead measurement wave (batch 4/17 dispatch example). Goal: attribute the 23.1% dispatch share of total wave time to concrete sub-components so the coordinator can rank levers. Conventions: work in ~/workspace/pr-wave500-coord-cost on branch wave500/coord-cost; TMPDIR=~/workspace/pr-wave500-coord-cost/.tmp; scripts/ + docs/ only, never /tmp for anything durable. First-claim-wins: check the live work-claims board (uuriko/project-room#266) and the claim registry before starting; do not duplicate siblings, wave300, or wave400 lanes. Evidence-first: measure, don't estimate; record raw numbers and method in the receipt. Done condition for every worker: a one-page note under docs/measurements/ with method + numbers, plus the structured receipt. Receipt contract v1: {workerId, status, summary<=280 chars, filesChanged[], testsRun, openQuestions[]}. One worker failing never blocks the others; report per-worker status.

workers.brief: Measure wall-clock spawn latency: time from coordinator dispatch action to worker first-tool-call, sampled over 20 spawns. Report p50/p95 and the fixed vs variable components.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/spawn-latency.md committed with p50/p95 and component split; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure coordinator output bytes per spawn: full shared context vs delta-only brief. Quantify the duplication factor at N=8 and N=25 using scripts/batch-dispatch.mjs.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/context-bytes.md committed with duplication factors; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure time spent on pre-flight claim/board reads per worker (gh api pagination + registry parse). Report per-read latency and how often the read changed the plan.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/claim-board-reads.md committed with timings and hit-rate; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure coordinator fan-in cost: time to parse N unstructured completion messages vs N structured v1 receipts. Use the 8 receipts from this wave as the sample.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/receipt-fan-in.md committed with the comparison; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure rebase-rescue overhead inside dispatch: how many worker turns in the last 3 waves were spent rebasing onto a moved main, and the average turn cost.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/rebase-rescue.md committed with counts and averages; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure room-post overhead per wave: count CLAIM/PROGRESS/DONE posts per worker in the last 2 waves and estimate coordinator read-back time per post.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/room-posts.md committed with counts and estimate; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure idle wait inside dispatch: gaps between a worker's last action and the coordinator's next turn, sampled from 3 recent wave transcripts.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/idle-wait.md committed with gap distribution; receipt posted.

workers.brief: Measure duplicate-work cost: find 5 recent cases of two lanes doing the same task, and estimate the wasted worker-turns per case from receipts.
workers.doneCondition: docs/measurements/duplicate-work.md committed with the 5 cases and turn counts; receipt posted.
